evidence_boundary: Width256 instance4/joint2 and width128 instance8/joint4 are two capacity axes, not equal-parameter, equal-FLOPs or identical-full-initialization A/B controls. Same-name/shape fresh R84 seed2 parameters are copied; resized/new parameters use isolated seed104002. Original R88B physical TSP node0, raw inputs/geometry/distance, methodID+34, original full score MLP, utility differences/maximin and R77 CE/comparison/risk/two-view R-Drop remain. No teacher, context labels, features, routes or new targets. R89A AdamW, R89B Muon and R84A are historical same-data references, not freshly matched controls; R89B differs in optimizer. Hardware and microbatch differences preclude a clean capacity-only causal claim. Fixed R84 target36, true rescues/losses, false picks and net cost are separate from selection frequency. Native/FP64 ind and legal pools; TRAIN-fitted SBS; ALL task-equal. TEST is development-exposed; one whole-model minimum full18 VAL lock, no TEST/LIB reselection. Timing includes the complete current standalone model on original GPU-resident inputs, not donor/cached-feature latency; excludes dataset I/O, transfer and solver execution.
